user.title: Connect to Daikin One
user.description: Enter the credentials for Daikin's official Open API. Your Daikin account password is not needed and is never requested.

data_description.email: Exactly as registered with Daikin. It is case sensitive.
data_description.api_key: From the developer menu under home integration in the Daikin app.
data_description.integrator_token: From home integration, get integration token, in the Daikin app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Daikin One
reauth_confirm.description: Daikin rejected the saved credentials for {account}. Enter a current API key and integrator token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Daikin One
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for {account}. The email must stay on the same Daikin account.

error.invalid_auth: Daikin rejected these credentials. Check the email (case sensitive), API key, and integrator token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Daikin. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: Daikin is rate limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Daikin account is already configured.
abort.account_mismatch: That email belongs to a different Daikin account than this entry. Add it as a new entry instead.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: Daikin does not allow polling more often than once every 3 minutes.

auth_failed.message: Daikin rejected the saved credentials. Re-authenticate the Daikin One integration.

rate_limited.message: Daikin is rate limiting requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

cannot_connect.message: Could not get a usable answer from Daikin ({reason}).

thermostat_unavailable.message: {name} is unavailable, so its current settings are unknown and the change was not sent.

thermostat_offline.message: Daikin reports that {name} is offline. The change was not applied.

state_unknown.message: Daikin needs the mode and both setpoints on every change, and {name} has not reported all of them. The change was not sent.

limits_unknown.message: {name} has not reported its setpoint limits, so the change could not be checked and was not sent.

setpoints_too_close.message: On {name} the cooling setpoint must be at least {delta} {unit} above the heating setpoint.

setpoint_no_room.message: {name} keeps its heating and cooling setpoints at least {delta} {unit} apart, and its limits ({minimum} to {maximum} {unit}) leave no room for that with the requested setpoint.
